patterns.name: Seeder Early Return Prevents Test Data on Restart
issueExamples: the page element with name 'Pending Reconciliation' is calling 'http://localhost:5173/api/v1/restaurants/1/purchasing/grns/stale' when hitting the url is not giveing the actaul data
patterns.rootCauseTemplate: The {SeederName} uses an early return condition `{condition}` which prevents {dataType} seeding on subsequent application restarts when tables already exist
patterns.fixTemplate: Move the {dataType} seeding logic outside the early return check, or make the early return condition more specific to only prevent duplicate seeding of {staticDataTypes}, not {transactionalDataTypes}
verificationSteps: Restart the application to trigger the seeder
Call the API endpoint that should return the data
Verify the response contains the expected records
If empty, check the seeder logic for early return conditions that prevent data creation

patterns.name: Date Filter Mismatch Between Count and List Endpoints
issueExamples: In the page element with name 'Pending Reconciliation', calling 'http://localhost:5173/api/v1/restaurants/1/purchasing/grns/stale' when hitting the url is not giveing the complete data
patterns.rootCauseTemplate: The {listEndpoint} query filters by date ({field} < :threshold), returning only items older than X days instead of ALL {itemType} that need {action}
patterns.fixTemplate: Remove the date filter from the list query to match the count query, OR create separate endpoints: one for ALL items (no date filter) and one for STALE items (with date filter)
verificationSteps: 1. Call the count endpoint (e.g., countUnmatchedGRNs) - note the count
2. Call the list endpoint (e.g., /stale) - note the count
3. Verify both return the same count after fix
4. Ensure recent unmatched GRNs now appear in the list
